# Provenance Tool

Official application: https://research-tools.xufentu.com
Canonical repository: https://github.com/xufentu-creator/provenance-tool
Originator and maintainer: Xufen Tu
Research website: https://xufentu.com
Current version: 0.4.3

Provenance Tool is a lightweight, local-first web application for creating portable file provenance records, recording SHA-256 file integrity values, verifying files and manifests, and comparing file-level changes.

Canonical citation metadata is available in CITATION.cff and CITATION.bib.
Chinese reference pages are available under /zh/.
